stem: A stem is severely damaged between the root system and the upper canopy. Which function is most directly at risk?
choices: Transport and structural support between roots and shoots
Regulation of seed dormancy through stored reserves in mature seed tissues
Determination of pollen identity through reproductive tissue development
Classification of glandular trichome color during floral maturation
rationale: Stems provide structural support and contain vascular tissues that connect root and shoot transport systems.
